distribution: Kam Tsin Village, Fanling, New Territories, Hong Kong.
soldier: Soldier: head deep yellow, thorax and abdomen slightly paler than the head, legs pale yellow, antennae dull yellow, two black bands on either side of the dorsal midline of the abdomen. The dorsum of the head and thorax with few hairs, the sides of the fontanelle with two hairs each, one hair between the fontanelle and each antennal socket, the tip of the labrum with a pair of apical hairs and a pair of subapical hairs and the disc with one pair, the dorsal margin of the abdomen with a few scattered short hairs. Head broadly oval, the sides and the middle of the posterior margin rather straight, appearing rather broad in proportion to its length. Fontanelle aperture nearly circular. Labrum rather narrow and long, its transparent tip projecting as an obtuse angle. Mandibles slender and long, their tips curved inwards. Antennae with 15 segments, the second larger than the third and the third smaller than the fourth. The surface of the postmentum with uneven transverse wrinkles, the widest area slightly raised, the oblique margins from the widest part to the anterior margin slightly concave near the posterior part, the narrowest part slightly behind the middle, the length of the postmentum slightly more than twice its greatest width. The middle of the anterior margin of the pronotum rather projecting, the median notch rather shallow and narrow, the median notch of the posterior margin broad and shallow. Length of the hind tibia 1.152–1.20 mm, spur formula 3:2:2.
